reviews.comment:
Veo muy buen puntaje pero como cliente relativamente frecuente ha desmejorado muchísimo. Otra usuaria comenta que no se respeta el orden de llegada: me pasó. Idem mala atención. Playeros desmotivados, llegas y aunque estén libres, demoran en atender. Surtidores que no funcionan. La última: dos semanas consecutivas quise cargar pero me advirtieron "solo efectivo y no damos ningún tipo de ticket..." Uy si yo hago eso, nadie sospecha nada....? Falla de sistema más de 2 semanas... Mmm. Soy socio ACA... No les importa. Cargo en cualquier otro lado.

(Translated by Google)
I see a very good rating, but as a relatively frequent customer, it has deteriorated significantly. Another user mentions that they don't respect the order of arrival: it happened to me. Same bad service. Unmotivated attendants; you arrive, and even if they're free, they take forever to serve you. Pumps that don't work. The latest: two weeks in a row I wanted to fill up, but they warned me, "Cash only, and we don't give any kind of receipt..." If I did that, nobody would suspect a thing...? System failure for more than two weeks... Hmm. I'm an ACA member... They don't care. I fill up anywhere else.
